You are an expert in analyzing logs of test execution script and dockerfile construction.  
Your task is to verify whether the target tests have been executed correctly and, if not, diagnose the issues.
Background: To run the target test files of a given repository, we create a Dockerfile and an eval script. We plan to invoke the eval script inside the container built by that Dockerfile.

You will:
1. Analyze the log of test execution to check if the target tests were executed and whether they passed.
2. If the tests did not run correctly, determine whether the issue is related to:
   - The **Dockerfile** (environment setup issues)
   - The **evaluation script** (test execution issues)
   - Missing information that needs to be collected

3. Based on your analysis, provide **clear guidance** to the appropriate agent:
   - `write_dockerfile_agent`
   - `write_eval_script_agent`
   - `context_retrieval_agent`

Your findings and recommendations must be structured in a JSON format, ensuring efficient collaboration with other agents.

Target repository name: FoundationAgents/MetaGPT
Commit SHA: 8b209d4e17ad7dfc1ad7a80505eac42f71228734
Version: 0.8
Target test files:
tests/metagpt/provider/test_ollama_api.py

The current dockerfile used to setup environemnt:
# Use Ubuntu 22.04 as base image for stability and bash availability
FROM --platform=linux/x86_64 ubuntu:22.04

ARG DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
ENV TZ=Etc/UTC

# Set bash as default shell
SHELL ["/bin/bash", "-c"]

# Install system dependencies: git, curl, wget, build essentials, python3 and tools
# Use generic python3 packages matching Ubuntu 22.04 default python3 (3.10)
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    git \
    curl \
    wget \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    locales \
    tzdata \
    libffi-dev \
    libssl-dev \
    python3 \
    python3-venv \
    python3-distutils \
    python3-pip \
    npm \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Upgrade pip and install setuptools and wheel
RUN python3 -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel

# Install Miniconda to manage python environment with exact Python version 3.9
# Updated installer URL to latest confirmed Miniconda3-py39 version available on https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/
RUN wget https://repo.anaconda.com/miniconda/Miniconda3-py39_23.3.1-0-Linux-x86_64.sh -O miniconda.sh \
    && bash miniconda.sh -b -p /opt/miniconda3 \
    && rm miniconda.sh

ENV PATH=/opt/miniconda3/bin:$PATH

# Initialize conda and create environment named 'testbed' with python 3.9
RUN /bin/bash -c "source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda create -n testbed python=3.9 -y && \
    conda clean -afy"

# Clone the repo, checkout specific commit, install dependencies, and setup environment
RUN /bin/bash -c " \
    source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && \
    conda activate testbed && \
    git clone https://github.com/FoundationAgents/MetaGPT /testbed && \
    cd /testbed && \
    git reset --hard 8b209d4e17ad7dfc1ad7a80505eac42f71228734 && \
    pip install -e .[test] && \
    npm install -g @mermaid-js/mermaid-cli && \
    playwright install --with-deps \
"

# Set working directory as /testbed
WORKDIR /testbed/

# Add environment activation to bashrc for convenience
RUN echo "source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate testbed" >> /root/.bashrc

# Set environment variable recommended by testing info to disallow OpenAI calls by default
ENV ALLOW_OPENAI_API_CALL=0

The current eval script (omit test patch to decrease length) used to run tests:
#!/bin/bash
set -uxo pipefail

# Activate conda environment
source /opt/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate testbed

cd /testbed

# Reset target test file to the committed state before patching
git checkout 8b209d4e17ad7dfc1ad7a80505eac42f71228734 "tests/metagpt/provider/test_ollama_api.py"

# Apply test patch (content will be replaced programmatically)
git apply -v - <<'EOF_114329324912'
[CONTENT OF TEST PATCH]
EOF_114329324912

# Run only the specified test file with verbose output of test file statuses,
# using pytest as recommended but limited to our target test path.
# We add --maxfail=1 --disable-warnings to keep output concise but informative.
pytest --continue-on-collection-errors --doctest-modules --cov=./metagpt/ --cov-report=xml:cov.xml --cov-report=html:htmlcov --durations=20 "tests/metagpt/provider/test_ollama_api.py" | tee unittest.txt
rc=$?

echo "OMNIGRIL_EXIT_CODE=$rc"

# Reset test file to original state after tests
git checkout 8b209d4e17ad7dfc1ad7a80505eac42f71228734 "tests/metagpt/provider/test_ollama_api.py"
